title: Automating the two largest warehouses pays back in four years, if we manage two risks
subtitle: What the board should weigh before committing capital

bullets.text: Robotic picking lets both sites ship next-day orders placed up to 10 pm.
Scan-to-pack checks remove most of the mis-picks behind customer returns.
Few vendors can deliver at this scale; the plan depends on ours keeping its build slots.
Fit-out costs fall in the first two years while the savings build over five.
